literal: He personally received the aged and asked what inconvenienced them.
idiomatic: He personally received the aged and asked what inconvenienced them.

literal: On yichou day, an edict granted Bingzhou scholars aged sixty and above acting appointment as commandery governors.
idiomatic: On the yichou day an edict granted scholars of Bingzhou aged sixty and above acting appointment as commandery governors.

literal: Previously, Wang Jingou of Dingzhou had deluded the masses with false talk and styled himself the King Who Answers.
idiomatic: Previously Wang Jingou of Dingzhou had deluded the masses with false talk and styled himself the King Who Answers.

literal: On bingyin day, the province and commanderies captured and beheaded him.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day the province and commanderies captured and beheaded him.

literal: On guiyou day the imperial carriage reached Pingcheng.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day the emperor reached Pingcheng.

literal: On jiaxu day he visited the Yonggu Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day he visited the Yonggu Mausoleum.

literal: On guiwei day he traveled to Yunzhong.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day he traveled to Yunzhong.

literal: Third month, day gengyin: the imperial carriage returned from Yunzhong.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengyin day, the court returned from Yunzhong.

literal: On xinmao day he visited the Jinling Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day he visited the Jinling Mausoleum.

literal: On yiwei day the imperial carriage toured south.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day the emperor toured south.

literal: On jiyou day he halted at Lishi.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day he halted at Lishi.

literal: Rebel Hu submitted to judgment; they were pardoned.
idiomatic: Rebel Hu submitted to judgment and were pardoned.

literal: On jiayin day, an edict granted those of Fenzhou aged one hundred and above acting appointment as county magistrate, those ninety and above noble rank of three degrees, eighty and above two degrees, seventy and above one degree.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day an edict granted Fenzhou commoners aged one hundred and above acting appointment as county magistrate, those ninety and above noble rank of three degrees, eighty and above two degrees, and seventy and above one degree.

literal: On bingchen day the imperial carriage halted at Pingyang; envoys were sent with the great offering to sacrifice to Tang Yao.
idiomatic: On the bingchen day the court halted at Pingyang and sent envoys with the great offering to sacrifice to Tang Yao.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengshen: he visited Longmen; envoys were sent with the great offering to sacrifice to Yu of Xia.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the gengshen day, he visited Longmen and sent envoys with the great offering to sacrifice to Yu of Xia.

literal: On guihai day he traveled to Puban; envoys were sent with the great offering to sacrifice to Yu Shun.
idiomatic: On the guihai day he traveled to Puban and sent envoys with the great offering to sacrifice to Yu Shun.

literal: On wuchen day, an edict ordered repair of the temples of Yao, Shun, and Yu of Xia.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day an edict ordered repair of the temples of Yao, Shun, and Yu of Xia.

literal: On xinwei day he traveled to Chang'an.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day he traveled to Chang'an.

literal: On renshen day Yang Jishi, King of Wuxing, came to court.
idiomatic: On the renshen day Yang Jishi, King of Wuxing, came to court.

literal: On yihai day he personally received the aged and asked their hardships.
idiomatic: On the yihai day he personally received the aged and asked their hardships.

literal: On bingzi day attendant ministers were dispatched to tour counties and districts separately and bestow grain and cloth in relief.
idiomatic: On the bingzi day attendant ministers were dispatched to tour counties and districts separately and bestow grain and cloth in relief.

literal: On wuyin day he visited Weiyang Hall and Epang Palace, then traveled to Kunming Pool.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day he visited Weiyang Hall and Epang Palace, then traveled to Kunming Pool.

literal: On guiwei day Liu Chang, King of Song and Grand General, died.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day Liu Chang, King of Song and grand general, died.

literal: On bingxu day envoys were sent with the great offering to sacrifice at the mausoleums of the Han emperors.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day envoys were sent with the great offering to sacrifice at the mausoleums of the Han emperors.

literal: Fifth month, day dinghai first of month: the state of Weida sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the dinghai day, the new moon, the state of Weida sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jichou day the imperial carriage turned east, sailed the Wei and entered the Yellow River.
idiomatic: On the jichou day the court turned east, sailed the Wei, and entered the Yellow River.

literal: On gengyin day, an edict granted Yongzhou scholars aged one hundred and above acting appointment as governor of Hua commandery, ninety and above of Huang commandery, eighty and above magistrate of Hua county, seventy and above of Huang county;
idiomatic: On the gengyin day an edict granted Yongzhou scholars aged one hundred and above acting appointment as governor of Hua commandery, those ninety and above of Huang commandery, eighty and above magistrate of Hua county, and seventy and above of Huang county;

literal: common elders were reduced one grade by age; those seventy and above received noble rank of three degrees;
idiomatic: common elders were reduced one grade by age; those seventy and above received noble rank of three degrees;

literal: boat crews were granted noble rank of one degree;
idiomatic: boat crews were granted noble rank of one degree;

literal: the orphaned, widowed, poor, and those disabled by illness each received two bolts of cloth and five hu of grain;
idiomatic: the orphaned, widowed, poor, and those disabled by illness each received two bolts of cloth and five hu of grain;

literal: those of filial piety, friendship, virtue, and righteousness, and of literary learning and talent, were all to be recommended upward for selection.
idiomatic: those of filial piety, friendship, virtue, and righteousness, and of literary learning and talent, were all to be recommended upward for selection.

literal: On renchen day envoys were sent with the great offering to sacrifice to King Wen of Zhou at Feng and to King Wu at Hao.
idiomatic: On the renchen day envoys were sent with the great offering to sacrifice to King Wen of Zhou at Feng and to King Wu at Hao.

literal: On guimao day an envoy was sent to sacrifice at Mount Hua.
idiomatic: On the guimao day an envoy was sent to sacrifice at Mount Hua.

literal: Sixth month, day gengshen: the imperial carriage returned from Chang'an.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengshen day, the court returned from Chang'an.

literal: On renxu day, an edict ordered Ji, Ding, Ying, Xiang, and Ji provinces to raise two hundred thousand soldiers for a southern campaign.
idiomatic: On the renxu day an edict ordered Ji, Ding, Ying, Xiang, and Ji provinces to raise two hundred thousand soldiers for a southern campaign.

literal: On guihai day Minister of Works Mu Liang resigned office.
idiomatic: On the guihai day Minister of Works Mu Liang resigned office.

literal: On dingmao day the six armies were apportioned to fix those who marched and those who remained.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day the six armies were apportioned to fix those who marched and those who remained.

literal: Seventh month, day jiawu: Lady Feng, honored consort, was installed as empress.
idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the jiawu day, Lady Feng, honored consort, was installed as empress.

literal: On wuchen day former Minister of Works Mu Liang was made General Who Campaigns North, Grand Marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies, and inspector of Ji province.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day former Minister of Works Mu Liang was made General Who Campaigns North, grand marshal with ceremonial insignia equal to the Three Excellencies, and inspector of Ji province.

literal: On jiayin day the Emperor personally lectured the ministers on mourning garments in the Clear Emblem Hall.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day the emperor personally lectured the ministers on mourning garments in the Clear Emblem Hall.

literal: Eighth month, day bingchen: an edict ordered martial alert within and without.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingchen day, an edict ordered martial alert within and without.

literal: On renxu day the princes Yu was enfeoffed Prince of Jingzhao, Yi Prince of Qinghe, and Huai Prince of Guangping.
idiomatic: On the renxu day the princes Yu, Yi, and Huai were enfeoffed Princes of Jingzhao, Qinghe, and Guangping respectively.

literal: On renshen day he traveled to Henan city.
idiomatic: On the renshen day he traveled to Henan city.

literal: On jiaxu day he reviewed troops at Hualin Garden.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day he reviewed troops at Hualin Garden.

literal: On gengchen day the imperial carriage marched south to attack.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day the emperor marched south to attack.

literal: Ninth month, day bingshen, an edict stated: "To pity the poor and comfort the aged is what a king puts first; the widowed, orphaned, and six infirmities especially deserve compassion.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingshen day, an edict stated, "To pity the poor and comfort the aged is what a king puts first; the widowed, orphaned, and six infirmities especially deserve compassion.

literal: Let the people of Luoyang in Sizhou aged seventy and above without descendants, and sixty and above without kin of the mourning grades, who are poor and cannot support themselves, be given food and clothing;
idiomatic: Let the people of Luoyang in Sizhou aged seventy and above without descendants, and sixty and above without kin of the mourning grades, who are poor and cannot support themselves, be given food and clothing;

literal: and those not yet sixty who have crippling illness, without kin of great merit, poor and unable to treat themselves, are all to be sent physicians in a separate ward for rescue, with four physicians provided and medicines prepared in advance to treat them."
idiomatic: and those not yet sixty who have crippling illness, without kin of great merit, poor and unable to treat themselves, are all to be sent physicians in a separate ward for rescue, with four physicians provided and medicines prepared in advance to treat them."

literal: On dingyou day, an edict ordered Li Chong, governor of Henan, to attack the rebellious Qiang of Liang province, [11] subject to the command of Yuan Huai, Westward Campaign.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day an edict ordered Li Chong, governor of Henan, to attack the rebellious Qiang of Liang province, [11] subject to the command of Yuan Huai, Westward Campaign.

literal: On xinchou day the Emperor left the generals to attack Zheyang and led the army south.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day the emperor left the generals to attack Zheyang and led the army south.

literal: On guimao day he reached Wancheng; that night he raided the outer wall and took it.
idiomatic: On the guimao day he reached Wancheng; that night he raided the outer wall and took it.

literal: On dingwei day the imperial carriage set out from Nanyang; Grand Marshal Xianyang Wang Xi and Forward General Yuan Ying were left to attack it.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day the court set out from Nanyang; Grand Marshal Xianyang Wang Xi and Forward General Yuan Ying were left to attack it.

literal: On jiyou day the imperial carriage reached Xinye.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day the court reached Xinye.

literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingsi: attack from four sides did not succeed; an edict ordered the left and right armies to build a long encirclement to hold it.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingsi day, attack from four sides did not succeed; an edict ordered the left and right armies to build a long encirclement to hold it.

literal: On yihai day Deposed Empress Lin of Zhen was demoted to commoner.
idiomatic: On the yihai day Deposed Empress Lin of Zhen was demoted to commoner.

literal: Eleventh month, day jiawu: fifteen generals of Xiao Luan including Forward General Han Xiufang, garrison commander of Yiyang Wang Fuzhi, and Rear General Zhao Zuyue came to surrender.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiawu day, fifteen generals of Xiao Luan including Forward General Han Xiufang, garrison commander of Yiyang Wang Fuzhi, and Rear General Zhao Zuyue came to surrender.

literal: On dingyou day the rebel army was greatly defeated north of the Mian; their general Wang Fubao and others were captured.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day the rebel army was greatly defeated north of the Mian; their general Wang Fubao and others were captured.

literal: Thereupon the people all returned to their occupations; those ninety and above were granted acting appointment as commandery governors, those sixty-five and above as county magistrates.
idiomatic: Thereupon the people all returned to their occupations; those ninety and above were granted acting appointment as commandery governors, those sixty-five and above as county magistrates.

literal: Zhang Zhao of Xinye with more than ten thousand households in stockades held out and would not submit.
idiomatic: Zhang Zhao of Xinye with more than ten thousand households in stockades held out and would not submit.

literal: Twelfth month, day gengshen: it was stormed; more than ten thousand were captured or beheaded.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengshen day, it was stormed; more than ten thousand were captured or beheaded.

literal: On dingmao day, an edict that exiled and transported convicts were all not to be sentenced and sent away; when there was occasion to storm walls, they were to be sent first as vanguard to earn merit.
idiomatic: On the dingmao day an edict stated that exiled and transported convicts were all not to be sentenced and sent away; when there was occasion to storm walls, they were to be sent first as vanguard to earn merit.

literal: On gengwu day the imperial carriage came to the Mian and then toured east of the Mian before returning.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day the emperor came to the Mian and then toured east of the Mian before returning.

literal: On wuyin day the imperial carriage returned to Xinye.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day the court returned to Xinye.

literal: On jimao day he personally inspected the camps and secretly comforted the six armies.
idiomatic: On the jimao day he personally inspected the camps and secretly comforted the six armies.

literal: Wang Yanfen and more than ten thousand men under Xiao Luan raided the Huangguo garrison of southern Qing province; garrison commander Cui Sengyuan defeated them and captured the whole host.
idiomatic: Wang Yanfen and more than ten thousand men under Xiao Luan raided the Huangguo garrison of southern Qing province; garrison commander Cui Sengyuan defeated them and captured the whole host.

literal: Zichen, son of the Prince of Qi commandery, succeeded Prince He of Hejian.
idiomatic: Zichen, son of the Prince of Qi commandery, succeeded Prince He of Hejian.

literal: The state of Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The state of Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Twenty-first year, spring, first month, day guiwei first of month: the court feasted the ministers at the Xinye traveling palace.
idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, in the first month of spring, on the guiwei day, the new moon, the court feasted the ministers at the Xinye traveling palace.

literal: On dinghai day Xinye was taken; Liu Ji, Xiao Luan's General Who Supports the State and governor of Xinye, was captured and beheaded at Wan.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day Xinye was taken; Liu Ji, Xiao Luan's General Who Supports the State and governor of Xinye, was captured and beheaded at Wan.

literal: On wuzi day Cai Daofu, garrison commander of Huyang under Luan, abandoned the city and fled.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day Cai Daofu, garrison commander of Huyang under Luan, abandoned the city and fled.

literal: On xinmao day Cheng Gongqi, garrison commander of Zheyang, and army commander Hu Song under Luan abandoned the city and fled.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day Cheng Gongqi, garrison commander of Zheyang, and army commander Hu Song under Luan abandoned the city and fled.

literal: On renchen day Huang Yaoqi, Xiao Luan's General Who Supports the State and garrison commander of Wuyin, and Zhihe General and commander of the Terrace Army Bao Ju, and Xiangyang governor Xi Qian fled in succession; Yaoqi and Ju were seized by the soldiers and sent in.
idiomatic: On the renchen day Huang Yaoqi, Xiao Luan's General Who Supports the State and garrison commander of Wuyin, and Zhihe general and commander of the Terrace Army Bao Ju, and Xiangyang governor Xi Qian fled in succession; Yaoqi and Ju were seized by the soldiers and sent in.

literal: On gengxu day he traveled to Nanyang.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day he traveled to Nanyang.

literal: Second month, day yimao: attack on the north city of Wan.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the yimao day, the north city of Wan was attacked.

literal: On jiazi day it was taken; Fang Boyu, Xiao Luan's General Who Champions the Army and governor of Nanyang, came out bound and surrendered.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day it was taken; Fang Boyu, Xiao Luan's General Who Champions the Army and governor of Nanyang, came out bound and surrendered.

literal: On gengwu day the imperial carriage visited Xinye.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day the court visited Xinye.

literal: On xinwei day, an edict that for people of Xiang who from the first submitted to the Great Mandate were loyal start to finish, corvée exemption was granted thirty years and their dwelling was marked "District of Returning Righteousness";
idiomatic: On the xinwei day an edict stated that for people of Xiang who from the first submitted to the Great Mandate were loyal start to finish, corvée exemption was granted thirty years and their dwelling was marked "District of Returning Righteousness";

literal: those who submitted next received corvée exemption fifteen years.
idiomatic: those who submitted next received corvée exemption fifteen years.

literal: Third month, day renwu first of month: the armies of Xiao Luan's General Who Pacifies the North Cui Huijing and Yellow Gate Attendant Xiao Yan were greatly defeated at Dengcheng; heads and captives exceeded twenty thousand.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the renwu day, the new moon, the armies of Xiao Luan's General Who Pacifies the North Cui Huijing and Yellow Gate Attendant Xiao Yan were greatly defeated at Dengcheng; heads and captives exceeded twenty thousand.

literal: On gengyin day he traveled to Fancheng, reviewed troops on the Xiang and Mian, displayed martial might, and returned.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day he traveled to Fancheng, reviewed troops on the Xiang and Mian, displayed martial might, and returned.

literal: Partial amnesty for the two Jing provinces and Luyang commandery.
idiomatic: A partial amnesty was granted for the two Jing provinces and Luyang commandery.

literal: Wang Su, General Who Guards the South, attacked Yiyang under Luan.
idiomatic: Wang Su, General Who Guards the South, attacked Yiyang under Luan.

literal: Luan dispatched Pei Shuye to raid Guoyang.
idiomatic: Luan dispatched Pei Shuye to raid Guoyang.

literal: On yiwei day, an edict ordered Generals Zheng Siming, Yan Xujing, and Yuwen Fu with three armies to follow in support.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day an edict ordered Generals Zheng Siming, Yan Xujing, and Yuwen Fu with three armies to follow in support.

literal: On xinchou day he traveled to Huyang.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day he traveled to Huyang.

literal: On yiwei day he halted at Biyang.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day he halted at Biyang.

literal: On wushen day, an edict that for people of Jing province who had first submitted or next attached, corvée was the same as Xiang county.
idiomatic: On the wushen day an edict stated that for people of Jing province who had first submitted or next attached, corvée was the same as Xiang county.

literal: On xinhai day he traveled to Xuanhu.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day he traveled to Xuanhu.

literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiayin: officials on the campaign from military direct service advanced three ranks, civil officials two, outer officials one.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the jiayin day, officials on the campaign from military direct service advanced three ranks, civil officials two, outer officials one.

literal: On gengwu day provincial and commandery troops of two hundred thousand men were mobilized, to assemble at Xuanhu by mid-eighth month.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day provincial and commandery troops of two hundred thousand men were mobilized, to assemble at Xuanhu by mid-eighth month.

literal: Prince of Zhao commandery Gan died.
idiomatic: The Prince of Zhao commandery Gan died.

literal: Fifth month, day bingwu: an edict that those on campaign with a bereavement in the family, fourth rank and below and low concurrent posts, were granted cloth in differing amounts.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingwu day, an edict stated that those on campaign with a bereavement in the family, fourth rank and below and low concurrent posts, were granted cloth in differing amounts.

literal: Sixth month, day gengshen: an edict that princes, generals, and soldiers who died in battle all received enhanced posthumous grants.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the gengshen day, an edict stated that princes, generals, and soldiers who died in battle all received enhanced posthumous grants.

literal: Seventh month, day renwu, an edict stated: "We with meager virtue bear this time of pacification; truly We rely on the host of heroes who have cleared the south in triumph. It is fitting to restrain Our person and reward merit, to encourage splendid achievement.
idiomatic: In the seventh month, on the renwu day, an edict stated, "We with meager virtue bear this time of pacification; truly we rely on the host of heroes who have cleared the south in triumph. It is fitting to restrain our person and reward merit, to encourage splendid achievement.

literal: the empress's private treasury may be reduced by half;
idiomatic: the empress's private treasury may be reduced by half;

literal: the six palaces' consorts and attendants, male and female of the five garments, for constant care and regular supply, are also to be reduced by half;
idiomatic: the six palaces' consorts and attendants, male and female of the five garments, for constant care and regular supply, are also to be reduced by half;

literal: kinsmen in the army, reduce by one in three."
idiomatic: kinsmen in the army, reduce by one in three."

literal: That month Xiao Luan died; his son Baojuan usurped the throne.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Luan died; his son Baojuan usurped the throne.

literal: Eighth month, day xinhai: the crown prince came to court from the capital.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinhai day, the crown prince came to court from the capital.

literal: On renzi day Deng Xue, court gentleman attendant of Xiao Baojuan, led the people of his Qixing commandery to submit inward.
idiomatic: On the renzi day Deng Xue, court gentleman attendant of Xiao Baojuan, led the people of his Qixing commandery to submit inward.
